channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Vermont’s Agency of Transportation is readying plow trucks for winter. Crews are installing plows and liquid salt systems on about two hundred fifty trucks. Starting December first, drivers will be on call twenty-four seven to clear snow.

The University of Vermont is expanding support for special needs students pursuing higher education. A new program received a one point two five million dollar federal grant. It will train special educators and provide scholarships for twenty-seven students over five years.

Vermont has spent nearly one billion dollars on Lake Champlain cleanup over ten years. The EPA says the state is not on track to meet its water quality goals. Vermont has achieved only thirty-five percent of the cleanup target so far.

Girl Scouts in Lake Luzerne built a mile-long solar system hike with planets to scale. The trail features signs and painted orbs showing planet facts and sizes. The project aims to inspire astronomy interest among campers and future scouts.
